Thanks again for the product walkthrough earlier today — the team at Atlas liked the latency/cost profile you showed. Procurement and legal here have asked for a mutual action plan (MAP) and a concise contracting timeline so they can slot this into our Q4 cadence.

Can we kick off a MAP? Specifically we'd like:
- Roles & owners for contracting and procurement
- An initial redline process (who reviews, expected turnaround)
- Target close date (we're trying to close by Oct 15)
- Any standard Redwood templates you expect us to comment on (MSA, SOW)

I've copied our procurement lead (Sanjay Rao) on this thread — he'll coordinate on the PO side. I can share our procurement timeline and any vendor forms if that helps.

Attaching: Atlas_internal_procurement_timeline.xlsx (see stub).

Looking forward to lining up a short kick-off call next week if that works.

Thanks,

Quick legal note for the kickoff and MAP:

- Preferred process: Atlas provides the contract (or we provide our standard MSA). Redlines via tracked changes are easiest; we can accept a PDF with comments but tracked Word is preferable.
- Turnaround: initial internal read within 3 business days; aim for 1-2 rounds of negotiation. If Atlas has a large vendor policy, expect additional review time.
- Key clauses we'll flag early: data residency & access, audit rights, liability caps, and termination for convenience. If Atlas requires SCCs or specific data processing agreements, please surface that before the kickoff.

Attaching our redline guidance (stub) — this is a one-pager that helps external counsel understand our layout and common fallbacks.

Rishi Malhotra
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com
